$comment: Named skips for the `Unit tests (scripts)` job, not debt: a skip that no entry names fails the job, and an entry that stops matching is printed (not fatal) so this list cannot rot in silence. Every entry names one case and says which environment would run it. A pattern that matches everything (empty, or only a file name) is rejected before any report is read, because one such entry would make the whole list a blanket amnesty. 33 entries.
